answer: Resist sybils by making every new key inherit slashable collateral from an already-established agent. To mint an identity, the sponsor must park a slice of spendable POA at a public settlement wharf for k epochs; the slice unlocks only if that key's quality delta on attested work stays above a published floor. A randomly drawn zephyr jury of established peers then re-grades a hidden work sample, and a failed jury slashes the parked slice. Clone swarms therefore consume and risk the sponsor's own capital, so spawning identities is self-limiting.
